# MailDev

> MailDev is a free, open-source local SMTP server and modern web inbox that catches every email your app sends during development. Point your mail transport at localhost:1025 and view the results at localhost:1080 — nothing reaches real inboxes. MailDev 3.0 adds a built-in Model Context Protocol (MCP) server, so AI agents like Claude, Cursor, and Codex can read the dev inbox.

Key facts:
- Run: `npx maildev`, or install globally with `npm install -g maildev` then `maildev`, or `docker run -p 1080:1080 -p 1025:1025 maildev/maildev`
- Default ports: SMTP 1025 (where your app sends mail), Web UI + REST API + MCP 1080
- Enable MCP: `maildev --mcp` (endpoint at http://localhost:1080/mcp), or run the standalone `maildev-mcp` stdio server for desktop AI tools. Works with any MCP client (Claude Desktop/Code, Cursor, Codex, Windsurf).
- License: MIT. Repository: https://github.com/maildev/maildev. Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/maildev
- MailDev 3.0 is a complete TypeScript rewrite (React web UI, Fastify API, MCP server) organized as a pnpm monorepo.
- MailDev is a development tool. It has no meaningful authentication story by default and must never be exposed to the public internet or used to handle production mail.

## Pages
- [Home](https://maildev.github.io/maildev/): Overview, features, and quickstart.
- [Documentation index](https://maildev.github.io/maildev/docs/): Every guide, integration, and reference page.

## Getting started
- [Overview](https://maildev.github.io/maildev/docs/): MailDev is a local SMTP server and web inbox for developers. Catch every email your app sends, read it in a browser or from an AI agent, and never risk sending test mail to a real person.
- [Install MailDev](https://maildev.github.io/maildev/docs/install/): Run MailDev with npx, install it globally with npm, or pull the Docker image. Node.js 20 or newer is the only requirement.
- [Quick start](https://maildev.github.io/maildev/docs/quickstart/): Point your app's mail transport at localhost:1025, send a message, and read it at localhost:1080. Copy-paste configuration for Node.js, Django, Rails, Laravel, Spring Boot, and anything else that speaks SMTP.
- [The web inbox](https://maildev.github.io/maildev/docs/web-ui/): A tour of the MailDev 3.0 web UI — message list, HTML and plain-text views, raw source, attachments, responsive preview, search, the command palette, and light and dark themes.

## AI & agents
- [MCP server](https://maildev.github.io/maildev/docs/ai/mcp/): Enable MailDev's Model Context Protocol server so Claude, Cursor, Codex, and any other MCP client can search your development inbox, pull verification links out of emails, and confirm delivery.
- [Claude Code walkthrough](https://maildev.github.io/maildev/docs/ai/claude-code/): A complete development loop with Claude Code driving MailDev over MCP — connect the server, build an email flow, and let the agent verify delivery and follow the link it finds.

## Guides
- [Docker & Docker Compose](https://maildev.github.io/maildev/docs/guides/docker/): Run MailDev as a container, wire it into a Compose stack so your app can reach it by service name, pass CLI flags and environment variables, and use the built-in health check.
- [HTTPS & TLS](https://maildev.github.io/maildev/docs/guides/https/): Serve the MailDev web inbox over HTTPS with a self-signed certificate, and configure TLS on the SMTP listener for clients that insist on an encrypted connection.
- [Testing email in CI](https://maildev.github.io/maildev/docs/guides/testing-in-ci/): Run MailDev as a GitHub Actions service container, assert on delivered mail over the REST API, and write end-to-end email tests with Playwright, Cypress, or Vitest.

## Integrations
- [Nodemailer](https://maildev.github.io/maildev/docs/integrations/nodemailer/): Configure Nodemailer to send development mail to MailDev, switch transports per environment, and verify the connection before your app starts sending.
- [Django](https://maildev.github.io/maildev/docs/integrations/django/): Configure Django's email backend to send development mail to MailDev, keep production settings separate, and test outgoing email with the Django test client.
- [Ruby on Rails](https://maildev.github.io/maildev/docs/integrations/rails/): Point Action Mailer at MailDev in development, preview mailers in the browser, and assert on delivered mail in system tests.
- [Laravel](https://maildev.github.io/maildev/docs/integrations/laravel/): Configure Laravel's mail driver to send development email to MailDev, use Mailable previews alongside it, and assert on delivered mail in Dusk and Pest tests.

## Reference
- [CLI & configuration](https://maildev.github.io/maildev/docs/reference/cli/): Every MailDev command-line flag, environment variable, and configuration-file key, with defaults and precedence rules.
- [REST API](https://maildev.github.io/maildev/docs/reference/rest-api/): The JSON API under /api for listing, reading, searching, downloading, relaying, and deleting mail — plus the Socket.IO events the web inbox uses for live updates.
- [Programmatic API](https://maildev.github.io/maildev/docs/reference/node-api/): Embed MailDev in a Node.js application or test suite: construct a server, listen for mail events, read and delete messages, and swap the storage backend.

## Comparisons
- [MailDev vs Mailcatcher](https://maildev.github.io/maildev/docs/vs/mailcatcher/): A factual comparison of MailDev and Mailcatcher, two open-source local SMTP catchers — runtime, install, web UI, API surface, relaying, and AI agent support.
